newsitem.title: UK: Marley shares up after analysts' U.S. visit.
newsitem.headline: Marley shares up after analysts' U.S. visit.

text.p: Shares in Marley rose on Friday amid positive feedback from an analysts' visit to the company's U.S. operations, dealers said.
By 1425 GMT the shares were up 4p at 135p in volume of around 2.5 million shares.
"There was nothing particularly that came from the U.S. visit that tells us the share price should be up 4p today," said one construction analyst.
"But there is so much negative feeling toward the company that any good news would have boosted the share price," said another.
Shares in the building materials company have staged a recovery from a low of 110p at the start of this year after a two-year period of steady decline.
